fact: A Western Cape Department of Community Safety statement on an assessment made between July and September 2019 says that in 2017 the ICDMS had been rolled out to 1153 or 80% of SAPS stations nationally and to 509 of 627 courts at a total cost of R613.5 million, and that none of the 11 stations assessed had linked ICDMS with external stakeholders.
title: MEC Albert Fritz on e-docket software not being effectively used by SAPS and Courts
